title: Technical English — Course 4, Semester 2 — Pilot Variant 12

tasks.prompt: Listening 1. When is the digital twin session scheduled?
tasks.audioText: The engineering software lecturer will explain digital twin terminology on Thursday at nine forty-five. Students should bring the lifecycle diagram. The session will compare a physical asset with its digital representation and discuss how operating data supports monitoring.

tasks.prompt: Listening 2. Which lifecycle diagram is needed?
tasks.audioText: The engineering software lecturer will explain digital twin terminology on Thursday at nine forty-five. Students should bring the lifecycle diagram. The session will compare a physical asset with its digital representation and discuss how operating data supports monitoring.

tasks.prompt: A digital twin is a digital representation of a physical asset or process linked to relevant information about its real-world counterpart. Depending on the application, it may use design data, operating measurements and maintenance history. Its usefulness depends on data quality and model accuracy. A digital model should not be assumed to reflect every real-world condition automatically. Reading 1. What information may support a digital twin?
options: Design data, operating measurements and maintenance history
Supplier invoices, delivery dates and purchase orders
Operator schedules, training records and attendance lists
Equipment colours, storage locations and parts prices
The number of pages in the model report
The presentation format and slide design
The number of people who use the equipment

tasks.prompt: The digital representation ___ with information about the physical asset.
A digital twin is being reviewed. Which TWO information sources may improve its accuracy?
A computer-based representation of a physical asset is a digital ___.
Before applying a model update, what should the team confirm?
options: Apply the newest model file immediately and check compatibility afterwards.
Could we update the model using the approved version and verified source data?
Use the model from a similar unit because the equipment family is the same.
Update the displayed model name and leave the configuration record unchanged.

tasks.prompt: Put the stages of digital twin concepts in a logical order.
options: Check the model against current asset data
Build or update its digital representation
Collect relevant design and operating information
Identify the physical asset or process
correctOrder: Identify the physical asset or process
Collect relevant design and operating information
Build or update its digital representation
Check the model against current asset data

tasks.prompt: Write 80–100 words explaining what a digital twin represents and why data quality and model updates matter.
tasks.rubric: 8 points total: a digital twin is described as a digital representation linked to a physical asset/process (0–2); the response explains why data quality and controlled model updates affect accuracy and usefulness (0–2); ideas are clearly connected with understandable grammar (0–2); digital-twin/data vocabulary, spelling and punctuation are accurate (0–2).
